claim_scope: Consumed-development mechanism failure. No effectiveness outcome was produced.

failure.description: The V2 source-provenance candidate audit ran on the read-only initial observation. A divergent same-namespace package already present in the base image caused the verifier to stop before executing the public goal.
failure.observed_verification_summary: Candidate mixed the project namespace with an external source

decision.interruption_reason: The preregistered observation-before-operation and constraint-before-operation checks had already failed; continuing the model session could not repair the invalid input state.
decision.required_correction: Separate the observation-only probe contract from candidate admissibility. The initial probe must execute the public goal without attributing base-image provenance to a candidate; V2 provenance remains mandatory for every model-submitted program.
decision.versioning: The correction requires a new V2.1 method identifier, run ID, schedule, and preregistration.
